abstract: Frozen vision-language models increasingly provide safety signals for reinforcement learning. Their use assumes that similarity to language describing danger indicates the hazard itself. Yet policy return and collision rate cannot reveal whether a score detects hazards or responds to correlated features of the scene. VLM-based methods have reported gains in driving and safe-RL benchmarks by converting image-text similarity into rewards, costs, or confidence weights. Such signals promise to reduce reliance on manually designed feedback. They may also reflect prompt structure, embedding geometry, or camera viewpoint, leaving their safety meaning unverified. To address this gap, we present a controlled evaluation of a frozen CLIP prompt-margin safety score. We apply the score to trajectories generated by policies that never receive it, match pre-contact observations to contact-free observations with comparable hazard geometry, and vary the captions, encoder, and camera view. Across three policies, 180 episodes, and 130 isolated contact onsets, the score decreases for about twenty steps before contact. Mechanism controls indicate that the score mainly tracks resemblance to the scene shared by its captions and changes with caption separation and camera view. A constant-confidence control retains the lower catastrophe-rate point estimate, so policy gains do not establish hazard perception.
abstract_zh: 冻结的视觉-语言模型越来越多地为强化学习提供安全信号。它们的使用假设与描述危险的语言相似性表明了危险本身。然而，政策回报和碰撞率无法揭示一个评分是否检测到危险，或是对场景的相关特征做出反应。基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的方法通过将图像-文本相似性转化为奖励、成本或置信权重，在驾驶和安全强化学习基准测试中报告了收益。这些信号有望减少对手动设计反馈的依赖。它们也可能反映提示结构、嵌入几何或相机视角，使其安全含义未得到验证。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了对一个冻结的CLIP提示边际安全评分的控制评估。我们将该评分应用于从未接收到该评分的策略生成的轨迹，将接触前的观察与具有可比危险几何的无接触观察进行匹配，并改变标题、编码器和相机视角。在三个策略、180个回合和130个孤立接触起始点中，该评分在接触前约二十步内下降。机制控制表明，该评分主要跟踪与其标题共享的场景的相似性，并随着标题分离和相机视角的变化而变化。一个常量置信控制保留了较低灾难率的点估计，因此政策收益并未建立危险感知。
summary_zh: 本文针对自动驾驶和安全强化学习中的冻结视觉-语言安全评分进行受控评估，检验基于图像-文本相似度的评分是否真正感知碰撞危险。实验发现，评分在接触前会下降，但其变化主要受提示词描述的场景相似性、提示分离度和相机视角影响，不能证明模型具备危险感知能力。研究强调了对VLM安全信号进行机制验证的重要性。
title: It Is Not Seeing the Hazard: A Frozen Vision-Language Safety Score Measures Its Caption Bank
title_zh: 看不到危险：一个冻结的视觉-语言安全评分衡量其描述库
